thread:
ops-incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 — monarch-prod VPC egress errors detected. Multiple services returning 502/timeout since ~2026-03-16T21:50Z. Affected: embedding/generate endpoints. Pager: @maria (oncall). Creating incident channel #inc-monarch-1719994321

maria (oncall): I'm on it. Can someone confirm measurable customer impact? @julian please ask Monarch CSM/tech contact.

julian (acct): Monarch reporting ~12% of requests failing to 502 and 200–500ms latency increase on embed endpoint. They say user-facing features degraded for a subset of customers. Asking for ETA and mitigation now.

devon (netinfra): I see sudden surge in TCP RST and connection resets from nodes in us-west-2 after netpolicy v1.2 rollout at ~21:48Z. Suspect rule ordering with kube-proxy/ipvs.

maria (oncall): Plan — rollback netpolicy canary immediately, observe 5 minutes, then full rollback if green. Devon, want you to execute canary rollback.

devon (netinfra): doing canary rollback now on monarch-prod. Command: ```bash
kubectl -n monarch-prod apply -f rollback/netpolicy-v1.1.yaml
# monitoring: kubectl get pods -l app=embed -o wide
```

ops-incident-bot: [ACTION] rollback started by devon at 1719994600. Monitoring hooks enabled.

tara (cust-success): I'll tell Monarch CSM/engineering that we've started rollback and will follow with an exec note once stable. Updating them in 5m.

maria (oncall): Traffic trending — 502 rate dropping from 12% -> 1.8% in the canary zone within 2m. Rolling out full rollback now.

devon (netinfra): full rollback applied across us-west-2. Applied in batches to avoid flapping.

leo (sre): Observability: retransmits and conn resets spike coincident with rollout. Post-rollback, packet retransmits down to baseline. Captured tcpdump snippets and conntrack logs.

sara (eng): Good. What we need next: short timeline for customer, RCA hypothesis (netpolicy rule ordering + ipvs interaction), and credit calc. Recommend drafting a concise exec summary for Monarch and an internal RCA doc.

julian (acct): Monarch legal/ops asking about SLA. Their contract 99.9% monthly. We should estimate downtime window and propose credits. I'll pull their usage numbers and forward to finance. @finance-bot can you standby for SLA calc?

finance-bot: Received. Please provide affected window timestamps and peak affected request volume. I will compute pro-rata credit options per SLA terms.

maria (oncall): Timeline (for initial comms): 21:48Z netpolicy rollout -> 21:50Z errors spike -> 21:52Z canary rollback started -> 21:55Z canary stable -> 21:58Z full rollback applied -> 22:03Z metrics back to baseline. Observed customer-visible impact ~21:50–22:03Z.

leo (sre): Attachments for RCA: conntrack dumps, tcpdump short capture (10s), grafana panels (5xx rate, latency P95), and rollout job events. I'll upload to incident docs.

devon (netinfra): Root-cause hypothesis: netpolicy v1.2 inserted ACCEPT/REJECT ordering that caused kube-proxy ipvs NAT table to evict established entries -> connection resets. Will include config diff and reproduction steps in RCA.

sara (eng): For mitigation next steps: (1) revert netpolicy change (done), (2) add e2e netpolicy tests in CI for ipvs clusters, (3) create a safety gate in rollout tooling to block netpolicy changes during high traffic windows.

maria (oncall): Owner assignments for follow-ups: devon -> mitigation & config diffs; leo -> telemetry and artifacts; sara -> engineering actions & CI changes; julian/tara -> customer comms; finance-bot -> SLA credit calc. We'll meet in 30m in #incidents to align exec note and credit proposal.

julian (acct): Monarch requesting an expedited exec summary for their CTO. I'll draft based on timeline and ask for owners to review. Target: 45m.

tara (cust-success): I'll coordinate the customer readout and schedule a short call if Monarch requests. We'll include the rollback timeline and next steps.

maria (oncall): Closing live mitigation phase — incident status: mitigated. Creating post-incident thread for Monarch post-incident action plan and RCA draft. Please add your artifacts to the doc: /incidents/1719994321/monarch-artefacts.

ops-incident-bot: [STATUS] mitigated -> monitoring. Incident will remain open for RCA and customer comms.

sara (eng): Suggest credit: 1 day pro-rata based on minutes impacted and SLA; will finalize after finance calc. Also propose follow-up internal postmortem and a short public-facing one-page summary for Monarch execs.

maria (oncall): Thanks all. If anything regresses ping me directly. Otherwise see you in the RCA sync in 30m. (reacted :thumbsup:)
